images.prompt: Premium editorial illustration, high-end tech magazine style: a dim server room where one engineer cheerfully mops the floor clean around a gleaming, freshly restarted rack — while a second engineer kneels close with a magnifying lens, examining the last remaining clue: a single thin red thread running under the rack. The room looks spotless; the story is not over. Deep dark navy (#161a45) dominant palette, soft cream (#F4EFE3) highlights, thin red (#eb2027) accent on the single thread only — no green, no purple, no rainbow palettes. No readable text, letters, or numbers anywhere. Cinematic moody lighting, minimalist composition.
